findings.rationale: Accepted (with the blocker): `unknown` restored with one meaning — adapter absent = no launcher to spawn — admitted only under shadow, refused under enforce at the point missionMode is known.

Accepted: frozen R2 wording wins. §1.2 now defines the absent adapter (no injected adapter AND no launcher on disk: spawnSync ENOENT/EACCES-on-missing, status null) → step cleanroom_probe unknown/shadow, admitted in shadow, refused with final_panel_seat_cleanroom_unavailable right after missionMode is computed (campaign-intake.js:1481-1483) under enforce, mirroring the enforced-readiness refusal (:1300-1326). Any real launcher outcome (incl. a missing bwrap) stays rejected in both modes because a diagnostic exists. §2 tests, §2.6, §4, §6 aligned.
Accepted: the resolver parity now iterates the schema enum too — a fixture config lists each enum runner as a qc seat in turn and asserts advisory / refusal / neither per tier.

Accepted: the probe spawns the launcher directly with spawnSync { timeout, killSignal: SIGKILL } (one process, no coreutils timeout); the launcher already passes bwrap --die-with-parent (cleanroom-launch.sh:198); ETIMEDOUT and spawn errors (status null) are mapped explicitly, so the table is exhaustive over spawnSync outcomes.

Accepted: the deny list is built from resolved candidates with git-common-dir omitted when git fails, HOME omitted when unset/empty, duplicates and `/` dropped; the step records deny_paths; a no-git, no-HOME fixture case is added.

Accepted: the step records `launcher` (resolved absolute path) so an env override is visible; the default resolves relative to the module dir and the codex mirror has the same relative shape with platforms/codex/plugin/scripts/lib/cleanroom-launch.sh present at base (1b-A sealed it).
Accepted: the plan states that depth-0 re-stamps doc, mirror and row in the release commit if the number differs, the same convention 1b-A used for (v2.36.62).
